about_short_description.short_description: HOKALI is a B2B marketplace for buying after school activities in the US.

product.name: After School Programs & Camps
product.description: A platform service that allows schools to discover, book, and manage onsite after school programs and day camps for students.

product.name: District Partnerships
product.description: A service offering centralized coordination and custom program design to implement enrichment programs consistently across multiple schools in a district.

product.name: HOKALI Platform
product.description: An online platform that enables schools to select, book, and manage enrichment programs, instructors, enrollments, payments, and attendance.

product.name: Summer Camps
product.description: A service offering customizable onsite summer camp programs in areas like sports, arts, and STEM, managed through the HOKALI platform.
